column1: =Once this unit takes <color=#f26c1c>3 instances</color> of targeted damage from attacks of opposite polarity, this unit gains 1 stack of <color=#3487e0>{3}</color>, to a maximum of <color=#f26c1c>1 stack</color> per turn.

column1: =Deals AoE Physical damage to the enemy with the highest HP and all enemies within <color=#f26c1c>3 tiles</color> of it, and deals AoE Physical damage to all enemies within <color=#f26c1c>5 tiles</color> of the target.

column1: =The damage from both instances can be shared.

column1: =Cleanses all stacks of <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> on enemies hit.

column1: =At the end of the Heavy Weapons Team's action, select the enemy target with the highest HP in <color=#f26c1c>Peripheral Battlefield 1</color> or the core battlefield, and deal AoE Physical damage equal to <color=#f26c1c>1000+125%</color> of Array Strength to them and all enemy units <color=#f26c1c>within a 3-tile radius</color>.

column1: =Consume all Energy; for every <color=#f26c1c>1 point</color> of Energy consumed, damage dealt increases by <color=#f26c1c>5%</color>, up to a maximum of <color=#f26c1c>25%</color>.

column1: =Deals AoE Physical damage equal to <color=#f26c1c>80%</color> of attack to all enemy units within <color=#f26c1c>5 tiles</color>, knocking them back by <color=#f26c1c>1</color> tile.

column1: =When there are <color=#f26c1c>2 or more</color> <color=#3487e0>Onyx Steles</color> on the field, stability damage dealt by Sextans' attacks is increased by <color=#f26c1c>3 points</color>.
